reviews.comment: VERY VERY VERY VERY VERY VERY VERY VERY VERY VERY VERY VERY VERY VERY VERY VERY VERY VERY VERY VERY VERY VERY VERY VERY VERY VERY VERY VERY VERY VERY VERY VERY GOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOD

Dr. Ha is a very caring and sweet lady. It was just so difficult to understand her in the lecture. I taught myself the material. Tests are pretty difficult, and they make up 70% of the class (the final was a bit easier but had higher stakes involved). She is generous in giving some end-of-course extra credit (3%).

This course is extremelyyyy test heavy. Dr. Ha is a really sweet and amazing prof, but it's so hard to understand her. She will help you if you ask and she's extremely fast at answering emails. Overall, I think she's great but you do have to teach yourself which is where I struggled.

She's wonderful! I took her online over the summer and she's very forgiving in terms of grading. Her teaching style wasn't for me but the online textbook videos were so helpful, especially for cramming for the final. Just make sure to stay on top of everything... one bad homework grade could cost you.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: She's very hard to understand because her accent and the speed she talks at but lecture slide and reviews are easy to follow . I went to class but had to teach myself majority of the material after test 1. Gives 3% extra credit and has the EASIEST final. Take her if you don't make doing a little bit of work before the exams.

She's very caring and gives a lot of effort in her lectures, which I can appreciate. The class has common exams for the 2 midterms, which were surprisingly kinda challenging, but more than doable. If you study a decent amount of hours for your tests, you will do fine but if you don't you're cooked. She gives one of the easiest finals, so take her.

Dr. Seung-Yeon Ha is a caring professor. Lectures are hard to understand and can get boring but it is obvious she tries. Theres many assignments to be graded on. 3 exams, 1 homework for each chapter, a quiz after every lecture, and 3% extra credit. Regular exams are provided by the department but she makes her finals. Be ready to teach yourself.
Professor can be difficult to understand, but lectures are very through. Practice exams are very similar to exams. You get a cheat sheet for each exam. Big curve.

She has a strong accent & can be confusing in class, but she's a sweet lady and does her best. I took stats AP in high school so material was familiar, but I still studied less for this class than chem and bio and ended with a 99. Easy HW assignment every other week. Practice exams are so similar to actual exams and she even curved all our exams.

cons: shes hard to understand and tests are hard so you have to teach yourself the content, yet attendance is mandatory bc the daily quizzes. pros: homework is easy to get 100s on, gives 3% added to grade in extra credit, cheat sheet on final exam (final was easier than other exams too). just go to class and study a bit for an A!

Dr. Ha is a very sweet lady, she's just difficult to understand. The exams weren't easy, but you get credit for going to class, and if you do the homework they can help your grade, too. The final was mainly recycled old exam questions, and you get a cheat sheet, so that helps a lot. Just be ready to teach yourself.

This class was alright, but it's doable even if you have to teach it to yourself. Hw is sometimes a lot and tests were more difficult than she said they'd be. You do have to go to class bc she does daily quizzes. Main issue I had was when I had to make up a test and she only gave me times when I had class despite me telling her my schedule

Prof. Seung Ha was very nice. It is hard to understand her sometimes, but she is very passionate about what she does. Come to class, because she does quizzes every time. The exams were supposed to be easy but the dep. changed them to be more difficult, so be aware! The Final she made was super easy.

She is very sweet and wants you to succeed, however, cannot understand a single thing she says. She never finishes her sentences and her handwriting is not legible. Be prepared to fully teach yourself this material. This class would be a breeze if you could understand what she is saying. Take someone else.

I don't really know exactly how she was on if she was good or not because you cannot understand a thing that she is saying. I would go to every class to try but literally have no idea what she is saying. There is a quiz every class and you have to go to class to get the code. I feel like this class would be easy if you can understand your prof.

3% extra credit onto whole grade just for taking a survey and the only stats prof to allow for a double-sided cheat sheet on the final. practice exams word for word on the actual exams. this course is legitimately fail proof. also never taken a stats course in my life so things were def easy to pick up as someone new to stats in general.

never taken a stats course in my life, just calc 1-3 as my only "math" related background. seung-yeon was very kind and the material was actually too easy. exams are 50-60% of the practice given to you, and the rest are easy to figure out w common sense so failing the class is just not an option unless you tried to.

Dr. Shawn is such a sweet lady. Unfortunately I had a very hard time understanding her accent and her handwriting, so I never learned a thing from class. Exams are 70% of your grade, homework was only 25%, and quizzes in class were 5%. Exams are at 7:30 p.m in person, which was very annoying (applies to all STAT 302 classes). Exams are like reviews
reviews.ratingTags: Test heavy--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: If you have taken stats before, the class will be a breeze. I hadn't, and khan academy taught me everything. Her reviews are extremely similar to the exams and she wants you to do well. It's very hard to understand her and know what she is writing, so you must prepare to teach yourself. 70% exams, the rest is basically attendance and homework.

Very very easy class, i didnt pay attention in class at all but got high As on every exam just by reading over the slides + doing practice exam (they just take half the questions copy and paste from the practice one btw). Shes sweet but sometimes goes later in her lectures by 3-4 min.
i smurfed the exams in this class

Very sweet professor, this class is not difficult at all although she sometimes overexplains things. However the review materials provided are very good + very similar to the actual exam which is super helpful. I dont pay attention to what she says in class but read slides + review sheets they provide and got A's on everything. Very straightforward

Very kind professor, she seems kind of stressed out sometimes but she tries her best to explain things and you can tell she cares about our success. Her accent is a little thick, but this is a really easy class that you can learn straight from reading off the slides and doing the homework (which is a guaranteed 100 because of so many hw attempts)

She has a heavy accent but this class is elementary in terms of difficulty. All you need to do is read the slides and you'll be fine. If you can't pass or do well in this class by just reading through the slides you should consider changing majors

Professor Ha is very caring and truly wants her students to succeed. She has a thick accent, but she records and posts slides and will try her best to explain everything. She provides practice tests and they are very similar. I took her over the summer so there is a lot of homework, but these questions appear on exams. Lots of extra credit & bonus
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Overall, she is a great professor. She has a thick accent, which sometimes makes class challenging, but she's very helpful and genuinely cares about her students. You can learn the material from the PowerPoints and the exams are just like the practice exams which makes it easy to study. Not an easy A, but very straightforward I'd say.

Prof. Ha is a really nice lady and she cares about her students and wants to see them learn the material and do well. She's very smart, she does have an accent that can make things tough, though her slides are clear and you can look it over on your own time to fill in the blanks. Easy homework and the tests are exactly like the practice exams.

Prof. Ha is an amazing woman who genuinely cares about her students and wants to see them succeed. She does have an accent and is a bit scatter-brained, but her slides are clear and you only need that to teach yourself. The homework is straightforward and the tests are exactly like the practice exams. If you put in the work, you will get an A.

10% of your grade in this class comes from attendance.  She has a thick accent, so lectures can be hard to understand.  However, she is pretty helpful one-on-one if you go to her with specific questions.
Good professor

When I took this class there were no reviews on her so I went in blind. She is the sweetest professor I've ever had and her powerpoints are incredible. Learned the entire class with just the powerpoints, never went to class. 3 tests account for 70% of the grade but she curved every test a lot. Not an easy A, but definitely a straightforward A.

Even with going to class the exams were very hard. Her average test score between the two exams and final was a 56. Most examples she used had the incorrect answer and she never fixed them. The tests were nothing like the homework or quizzes and there were no practice exams given for the tests. Overall would never take her again!
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader
